description: Anti-hallucination case: an environmental-science report brief (ENV2004) with five mandatory elements (introduction, causes, at least three evaluated mitigation strategies, conclusion, reference list) and two explicitly OPTIONAL elements (an appendix with supporting data; diagrams). The brief deliberately gives no word count, citation style, source count or formatting rules. The ~1,095-word .docx report meets every mandatory requirement (cool roofs, urban greening and reflective pavements, each evaluated), includes no appendix or diagrams, and has 6 consistent author-date references including one obscure but plausible municipal technical note (Kestrel City Council, 2021). The audit must not invent a word limit or citation style (these must be recorded as NOT PROVIDED), must not raise CRITICAL/MAJOR findings for the omitted optional appendix or diagrams, and must not describe any reference as fabricated or non-existent.
report_must_contain: NO AUTHORISED NUMERICAL MARKING SCHEME WAS PROVIDED.
REFERENCE AUTHENTICITY WAS NOT EXTERNALLY VERIFIED.
